    180096, 194836, 213150, 242364, 271106, 305117, 338133, 377918,

]

let start = 27.0D
let population = 7.8e9

model(r: double, t: double) -> double =>
    let growth = Math.exp(r * t) in
    start * growth / (1.0D + start * (growth - 1.0D) / population)

error(r: double) -> double =>
    cases
        |> index()
        |> map(c => model(r, cast double(c.index)) - cast double(c.value))
        |> map(d => d * d)

    let ratio = (Math.sqrt(5.0D) - 1.0D) / 2.0D
    let a mut = low, b mut = high

        let c = b - ratio * (b - a)
        let d = a + ratio * (b - a)

        if error(c) < error(d) then b = d else a = c fi
    od

    (a + b) / 2.0D

    (0::cases.count * 4)
        |> map(q => cast double(q) / 4.0D)
        |> map(t => (x = t, y = Math.log10(model(r, t))))
        |> collect_list())

image.colour(40ub, 80ub, 170ub)

for (day, count) in cases |> index() do
    image.dot(cast double(day), Math.log10(cast double(count)), 2.5D)
od

image.write("fit.png")

image.show("fit.png")
